change.summary: Ten action-chain store families now share one PostgreSQL, scope, role, and ledger initializer while retaining their own fail-closed error contract.

measurement.method: sealed PC01 _measure_sources implementation against committed HEAD

verification.initialOperatorCommandCause: The first PostgreSQL command used the valid 4B disposable prefix instead of the stricter action-chain disposable prefix. Every case stopped before migration or test execution; the correctly named empty database then passed all 95 cases.

nonClaims: This checkpoint does not deploy a new Eva2 image or modify a live database.
The existing action-chain feature set is preserved; this is a maintenance reduction, not a new autonomy capability.
The Windows and WSL reboot gate and the seven-day acceptance run remain open.
nextRequiredAction: Remove or replace at least 13730 more measured product lines without weakening the source boundary or proven capabilities.
